unit: City Form Lab (Department of Urban Studies and Planning)
pi_title: Head of the City Design and Development Group; Associate Professor (with tenure) of Urban Science and Planning, MIT DUSP
location: MIT, 77 Massachusetts Ave., Room 10-404, Cambridge, MA 02139
research_summary: Studies the influence of urban form on sustainable travel behavior and the public qualities of built environments -- urban ground floors, main streets and amenity location patterns -- using spatial analytics and the Urban Network Analysis framework the lab develops.
member_breakdown: 1 PI, 4 researchers (PhD/Master's students: Liu Liu, Freya Tan, Keara Dennehy, Mohamed Elgohary), 10 collaborators (PhD students, postdocs and visiting researchers, several based at partner institutions: Aziz Alhassan, Justin Kollar, Helen Tera, Adrian Helmut Georges, Rounaq Basu, Maryam Hosseini, Nicola Colaninno, Dylan Halpern, Raul Kalvo, Chu Li)
notes: People page lists Researchers and Collaborators separately from a 'Past Researchers' section (alumni excluded from member_count). Two listed collaborators (Rounaq Basu, Maryam Hosseini) are noted on the page as having finished/about to finish their postdocs and move to faculty positions elsewhere but are still shown under the current (not past) section as of the page's content, so kept in the count -- the page's own listing was followed rather than second-guessed. No admin contact or join/apply page shown.

unit: MIT CoLab / Community Innovators Lab (Department of Urban Studies and Planning)
pi_title: Executive Director, MIT CoLab
location: MIT, Building 9-238, 77 Massachusetts Avenue, Cambridge, MA 02142
research_summary: A DUSP-based hub for collaborative action research and innovation with communities at the margins, working on democratizing economies and self-determination.
join_notes: Page states no open staff roles at time of check; links to the MIT applicant site for postings and to DUSP's own student-opportunity board.
notes: CoLab is a DUSP center, not a single PI's research lab -- recorded Executive Director Holly Harriel as the operational lead. J. Phillip Thompson is Faculty Director and Dayna L. Cunningham is Founder. A 12-person 'Faculty Council' of DUSP professors (J. Phillip Thompson, Delia Wendel, Catherine D'Ignazio, Mariana Arcaya, Karilyn Crockett, Jason Jackson, Lawrence Vale, Lawrence Susskind, Anne Whiston Spirn, Karl Seidman, Ceasar McDowell, Gabriella Carolini) is listed but these are DUSP faculty whose primary labs/pages are recorded under their own department profiles elsewhere, not duplicated here; several run their own named initiatives within CoLab (e.g. Katrin Kaeufer directs 'Just Money'). Students, Strategic Partners, Community Advisory Board and Alumni lists are long, dated and not individually itemized -- no emails shown for any of them on this page.
